recipes.name: Doro Wat
recipes.ingredients: Chicken, berbere, onions, niter kibbeh, eggs, garlic, ginger
recipes.description: Spicy Ethiopian chicken stew with boiled eggs, the national dish of Ethiopia. Rich, flavorful, and deeply satisfying.

recipes.name: Shiro
recipes.ingredients: Chickpea flour, berbere, garlic, onions, tomatoes, oil
recipes.description: Comforting chickpea stew, perfect for fasting days. Quick to make and packed with protein.

recipes.name: Injera
recipes.ingredients: Teff flour, water, salt, starter culture
recipes.description: Traditional sourdough flatbread with a spongy texture, the base of every Ethiopian meal. Fermented for 3 days for the perfect tang.

recipes.name: Kitfo
recipes.ingredients: Beef, mitmita, niter kibbeh, cardamom, salt
recipes.description: Minced raw beef delicacy with spicy butter and mitmita. A traditional dish for special occasions.

recipes.name: Buna (Coffee)
recipes.description: Traditional Ethiopian coffee ceremony. Freshly roasted and brewed coffee served with popcorn or snack.

recipes.name: Sambusa
recipes.ingredients: Flour, lentils, onion, garlic, berbere, oil, salt
recipes.description: Crispy fried pastries with savory lentil filling. Perfect street food and appetizer for any gathering.

recipes.name: Ayib
recipes.description: Fresh Ethiopian cottage cheese, mild and creamy. Often served as a side to balance spicy dishes.

recipes.name: Gomen
recipes.ingredients: Collard greens, garlic, ginger, onions, oil, salt
recipes.description: Sautéed collard greens with aromatic spices. A healthy and flavorful side dish.

recipes.name: Firfir
recipes.ingredients: Injera, berbere, onions, niter kibbeh, tomatoes, garlic
recipes.description: Shredded injera with spicy sauce, a quick and hearty breakfast. Perfect for using leftover injera.

recipes.name: Tej
recipes.description: Ethiopian honey wine, sweet and aromatic. Takes 2 weeks to ferment, worth the wait.

recipes.name: Zilzil Tibs
recipes.ingredients: Beef strips, awaze sauce, onions, garlic, rosemary, oil
recipes.description: Grilled beef strips with awaze sauce, tender and flavorful. A favorite among meat lovers.

recipes.name: Atakilt Wat
recipes.ingredients: Cabbage, carrots, potatoes, turmeric, garlic, onions, oil
recipes.description: Slow-cooked vegetable stew with turmeric, mild and comforting. Great for fasting days.

recipes.name: Kolo
recipes.ingredients: Barley, chickpeas, sunflower seeds, salt, spices
recipes.description: Traditional Ethiopian snack mix of roasted grains and seeds. Healthy and addictive.

recipes.name: Niter Kibbeh
recipes.ingredients: Butter, garlic, ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves
recipes.description: Spiced clarified butter, the foundation of Ethiopian cooking. Infused with aromatic spices.

recipes.name: Kicha
recipes.description: Quick pan-fried flatbread, often served with eggs for breakfast. Light and versatile.
